retrieved.title: Co-op Marketing and Demo Unit Program
retrieved.heading: Co-op marketing
retrieved.text: Partners can ask for co-op marketing support. This can cover local ads, fair or trade show booths, and store signage. Fernhollow does not list amounts on this page. The Partner team sets what it can support for each request.

retrieved.title: Fernhollow Partner Program Overview
retrieved.heading: Related pages
retrieved.text: For territories, see the Partner Territory FAQ. For tiers, see Partner Tiers and Requirements. For marketing support and demo units, see the Co-op Marketing and Demo Unit Program.

retrieved.title: Partner Tiers and Requirements
retrieved.heading: What each tier looks for
retrieved.text:
- Bronze: a new or small partner. It sells Fernhollow machines and may do basic service.
- Silver: a partner with a larger volume, at least one trained technician, and a demo unit on display.
- Gold: a partner with the highest volume, several trained technicians, demo units on display, and full warranty service capability.
The Partner team sets the exact requirements in the signed partner agreement.
